stories.title: Create Author Bio Component with Avatar and Social Links for Blog Posts
stories.description: Add a reusable author card component to display on blog post pages. Shows author avatar, name, bio excerpt, and social media links. Includes schema.org Person markup for improved SEO and author identification.
acceptanceCriteria: Author bio card renders below blog post title with avatar, name, and bio text
Social media links (Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub) display and link correctly
Person schema markup included in structured data with name, image, url, and sameAs properties
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/types/blog.ts — add author field to BlogPost interface with name, avatar, bio, social links
File to create: site/src/components/AuthorBio.tsx — render author card with Person JSON-LD schema
Test command: npm run test -- site/src/components/AuthorBio.tsx -t 'renders author name and social links'

stories.title: Add Intelligent Excerpt Generation for Blog Cards with Proper Truncation
stories.description: Create a utility function that extracts clean excerpts from blog post markdown content without breaking HTML tags or cutting sentences mid-way. Excerpts display on blog listing cards and OG meta descriptions with proper character limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Excerpts truncate at 160 characters maximum without cutting words or breaking sentences
Markdown formatting and HTML tags are stripped; plain text only in output
Function handles edge cases: lists, code blocks, emphasis markers without corruption
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/blog-excerpt.ts — implement truncateToSentence(markdown: string, maxChars: number) function
File to edit: site/src/components/BlogCard.tsx — replace inline truncation with excerpt utility
Test command: npm run test -- site/src/lib/blog-excerpt.ts -t 'truncate' (verify edge cases and sentence boundaries)

stories.title: Implement Blog Post Scheduling System for Planned Content Publication
stories.description: Enable scheduling blog posts for future publication dates. Posts remain in draft status until their scheduled publish date, then automatically become public. Admin dashboard displays scheduled posts with publication countdown. Supports content calendar planning and staggered content releases.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogPost type includes optional scheduledPublishDate field
Posts with future publish dates exclude from public blog listing and RSS feed
Admin view shows scheduled posts sorted by publish date with countdown timer
Scheduled posts automatically become live at publish time (via server-side date check)
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/types/blog.ts — add scheduledPublishDate?: Date field to BlogPost
File to create: site/src/lib/blog-scheduler.ts — implement isScheduledFuture(post: BlogPost) boolean helper
File to edit: site/src/app/blog/page.tsx — filter out scheduled posts: const published = allPosts.filter(p => !isScheduledFuture(p))
Test command: npm run test -- site/src/lib/blog-scheduler.ts -t 'isScheduledFuture'

stories.title: Generate Dynamic OpenGraph Images for Blog Posts Using ImageResponse
stories.description: Use Next.js ImageResponse to dynamically generate unique social preview images for each blog post. Images display blog title, author name, publication date, and featured image as background. Improves click-through rates on social media shares.
acceptanceCriteria: OG image generated at /blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.jsx route without errors
Social preview displays blog title, author name, publish date, and featured image
og:image meta tag in page head correctly references generated image URL
Twitter/Facebook/LinkedIn social share previews render correctly with generated image
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.jsx — implement using ImageResponse with Satori, include title/author/date/image
File to edit: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx — add generateMetadata() function with openGraph.images config
Test command: npm run build && grep 'og:image' .next/static/chunks/index.html | head -5

stories.title: Add Internal Link Validator for Blog Posts to Prevent Broken Cross-References
stories.description: Create a build-time validation script that scans all blog post markdown files for internal links and verifies they point to existing blog posts or pages. Build fails with clear error messages if broken links are detected. Integrates into CI/CD pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scans all blog .mdx/.md files and identifies internal links matching /blog/, /guide/, /rooms patterns
Validator checks each internal link target exists as published blog post or page
Reports broken links with file name, line number, link URL, and suggested fix
Runnable via npm run validate:links and returns exit code 1 on failures
technicalNotes: File to create: site/scripts/validate-blog-links.ts — parse markdown, extract links, validate against blog registry
File to edit: site/package.json — add script: 'validate:links': 'tsx scripts/validate-blog-links.ts'
Test command: npm run validate:links (intentionally add /blog/nonexistent to a test post and verify error reporting)
